ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The right side of the figure is marked with a 12 V voltage, connected to the upper and lower two black nodes. At the top there is a 6 Ω resistor connecting the upper-left node and the upper-right node; inside on the left there is a 3 Ω resistor connecting the upper-left node and the lower-left node; on the right vertical branch there is a 6 Ω resistor connecting the upper-right node and the lower-right node; at the bottom there is a 4 Ω resistor connecting the lower-left node and the lower-right node. Ammeter A1 is on the far-left branch, connecting the upper-left node and the lower external wire; ammeter A2 is on the diagonal branch, connecting the lower-left node and the upper-right node. Reasoning: According to the specified method, treat both ideal ammeters as short circuits. After A1 is shorted, the upper-left node is at the same potential as the lower terminal node of the power supply; after A2 is shorted, the lower-left node is at the same potential as the upper terminal node of the power supply. Therefore the left 3 Ω resistor and the upper 6 Ω resistor are both directly connected across the 12 V power supply. The current in the 3 Ω resistor is I=12/3=4 A; the current in the upper 6 Ω resistor is I=12/6=2 A. These two currents merge at the node flowing toward the branch where A1 is located, so the reading of A1 is 4 A + 2 A = 6 A.

raw_record.question_text: In the circuit shown in the figure, the reading of ammeter A1 is ________ A.

method.method_draft: First describe the circuit connections in the image. Treat both ammeters as ideal short circuits. Collapse the nodes joined by A1 and by A2. After this reduction, note that the 3 Ω left resistor and the upper 6 Ω resistor both connect between the source top node and the source bottom node, so each has 12 V across it. Compute their currents with Ohm's law and add them at the node that feeds the A1 branch: 4 A through 3 Ω plus 2 A through the upper 6 Ω gives the A1 current, 6 A.

推理：按指定方法，把两个理想电流表都看成短路。A1 短接后，左上节点与电源下端节点等电位；A2 短接后，左下节点与电源上端节点等电位。因此左侧 3 Ω 电阻和上方 6 Ω 电阻都直接接在 12 V 电源两端。3 Ω 电阻电流为 I=12/3=4 A；上方 6 Ω 电阻电流为 I=12/6=2 A。这两股电流在流向 A1 所在支路的节点处汇合，所以 A1 的读数为 4 A + 2 A = 6 A。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct node-short/equipotential reduction: identify the two ideal ammeters as wires, reduce the circuit to parallel resistors, then use KCL at the node containing A1 to get its current.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read from the figure: a 12 V source is applied between the right top and right bottom terminals; resistors are labeled 6 Ω on the top branch, 6 Ω on the right vertical branch, 3 Ω on the left inner vertical branch, and 4 Ω on the bottom branch; ammeter A1 lies in the outer left/bottom wire connecting the top-left node to the bottom-right node; ammeter A2 lies on the diagonal connecting the bottom-left node to the top-right node.
planner_metadata.text_role: The text asks specifically for the numerical reading of ammeter A1 in amperes; no additional numeric data are supplied outside the diagram.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the ideal-ammeter rule that an ammeter has negligible resistance and acts like a short circuit. Therefore A1 makes the top-left node equipotential with the bottom-right terminal, and A2 makes the bottom-left node equipotential with the top-right terminal. Then the top 6 Ω and left 3 Ω resistors are each directly across the 12 V supply. Their currents are 12/6 = 2 A and 12/3 = 4 A, and by Kirchhoff's current law these two currents combine through A1, so A1 reads 2 + 4 = 6 A.
